run_attentive_nas_evaluation: run the AttentiveNAS model evaluation script with a config file, model variant, and GPU ID
test_pareto_subnet_model: test a specific Pareto subnet model (a0-a6) using the AttentiveNAS evaluation CLI
build_data_loader_for_eval: build train and validation data loaders from config arguments for model evaluation
create_model_from_supernet: create a static AttentiveNAS model with weights inherited from the supernet using model_factory
calibrate_bn_running_stats: calibrate batch normalization running statistics by forwarding training batches through the model
